entities.summary: Sabriye Gönülkırmaz is a Turkish volleyball player. She is 186 cm (6.10 ft) tall at 78 kg (172 lb). She has played in the past as wing spiker, later changing her position to middle blocker. She currently plays for Yeşilyurt Women's Volleyball Team, which competes in the Turkish Women's Volleyball League. Gönülkırmaz is a member of the Turkey women's youth national volleyball team, and wears number 13.
